title: Fast Delights
description: Fast Food, in Minecraft. Now you can be Unhealthy in game too!
body:
Fast Delights is a addon for Farmers Delight that adds new foods, primarily focused on ones you would find in a Fast Food Restaurant. 

![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)

Currently Implemented

- Chips

This is only early days and more is planned such as...
- Burgers
- Soft Drinks
- Ice Cream
- Nuggets
- Tacos

And more!
